candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student LVS Data Analyst position. Building dashboards, validating data and benchmarking KPIs to support decisions in an international team is the work I have done and want to keep growing in.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, building dashboards, data models and SQL-based reporting for business teams.

achievements.impact: I replaced a quality check where users opened an SAP report for each of thousands of materials and compiled results in Excel with a single SAP Analytics Cloud dashboard
I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
I built a Power BI dashboard for the CEO comparing monthly sales against the fiscal-year plan

letter.problems_section: In your team I would develop dashboards and automated reports, run data validation and quality controls, and support KPI benchmarking and project analysis. I am comfortable working under time pressure and communicating across teams.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to the Düsseldorf area. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
